retrievalProfile.description: A dense collage of 3D animated characters with blue skin and white hats, featuring bold layered bubble typography and a promotional sticker overlay.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, crowded composition of 3D rendered characters with distinct blue skin and white caps, arranged in a multi-layered collage. The central focus is a large, stylized title in blue and white bubble letters with a thick outline, accompanied by a white rectangular promotional sticker in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters overlapping to create depth and density
High-contrast blue skin against white hats and red accents
Bold, outlined typography layered over the character collage
Promotional sticker breaking the primary composition grid
coreInvariants: Primary color palette of blue, white, and red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are scaled to fill the frame, with faces occupying the majority of the space in a tight, overlapping grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue character with a grumpy expression and the large bubble-letter title below it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left sticker to the central character, then down to the title, and finally around the perimeter to the various supporting characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with character faces and graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red (hat and clothing) and yellow (flower accessory)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value, creating a bright, kid-friendly aesthetic.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy dark blue outlines with white inner strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'M' are interlocked or closely kerned to follow a curved path
The numeral '2' is larger and features a distinct 3D bevel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Playful custom bubble lettering for the brand title paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for informational text.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, playful nature of the title
Appropriate for the clean informational text on the sticker

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense collage of 3D animated blue-skinned characters with white hats, varying expressions, and one character wearing sunglasses and a red hat in the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large blue bubble-letter title with a white outline in the lower center, and a white rectangular sticker with blue sans-serif text in the upper left corner.

verificationChecks: Characters have blue skin and white hats
White sticker is present in the top left

mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid copyright
Specific artist names on the sticker
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no characters look distorted or uncanny
Check that the sticker looks like a physical overlay
Verify the bubble letters have a consistent outline thickness
Confirm the blue skin tone is consistent across characters
recipe.reuseFormula: 3D Character Collage + Bubble Typography + Sticker Overlay
